picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's leadership of 13 Genesis Mission AI projects (plus partnership on 30+ more) makes it the single largest node in DOE's new national AI-for-science initiative, signaling where federal research priorities and dollars are concentrating.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge's selection to lead nine Genesis Mission projects and contribute to 32 more cements the national labs' central role in the AI-for-science buildout, on par with Berkeley Lab's footprint.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the Genesis Mission, alongside 15+ federal agencies under an executive order, shows the initiative expanding from a DOE program into a genuine whole-of-government AI strategy with real policy weight.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: A £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation for CuspAI, led scientifically by an Imperial College researcher, is a rare hard financial data point in a week otherwise dominated by grant announcements.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: USC's six Genesis Mission awards across a single university illustrate how concentrated the DOE funding wave is becoming at top research institutions.
picks.title: Multiple USC-led projects receive U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission awards to advance AI

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20M NSF award to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node points to a parallel, NSF-run track of automated-science infrastructure investment beyond DOE's Genesis Mission.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT deepening their AI/robotics partnership, with faculty exchanges backed by €1.6M from the Bavarian government, is a concrete transatlantic academic collaboration rather than a domestic grant award.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS's Apertus 1.5 release adds multimodal capability to one of the few fully open, sovereign large language models trained outside the major US/China labs.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: A new deep-learning model from CMU, Pitt, and UW revealing 3D genome differences in Alzheimer's patients is a genuine scientific advance with direct disease-mechanism implications, distinct from the week's funding-announcement wave.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.editorial_note: NEURA Robotics and RWTH Aachen's new 3,000 sq. meter 'Physical AI' facility is a notable industry-academia bet on real-world humanoid robot training data, a distinct application area from the Genesis Mission science grants.
picks.title: A Milestone for Physical AI | RWTH Aachen University | EN
